messages:
elena: quick heads-up, onboarding MarlinPay's LoRA on redwood/helix-13b-int4. Quick smoke shows numbers being concatenated and losing decimal points in payment examples. anyone seen this pattern?
sam: can you paste a failing pair?
elena: sure: 
```
User: "Amount to pay: $14.20"
Model: "Amount: $1420"
```
and
```
User: "Payment: 7.890,50 EUR"
Model: "Payment: 789050 EUR"
```
kai: that smells like tokenizer merges from the adapter. Did the conversion step import MarlinPay's merges.txt?
elena: pipeline log says converter step applied with default precedence (adapter-first). i didn't notice a custom merges file earlier but looks like it got in.
sam: can you dump tokenization for the second case?
elena: token dump: 
```
base_tokens: ["Payment", ":", " ", "7", ",", "890", ",", "50", " ", "EUR"]
adapter_tokens: ["Payment", ":", " ", "789050", " ", "EUR"]
```
so commas and decimal marker absorbed into a single numeric token.
kai: yep. quick experiment: apply adapter weights but force base tokenizer -> preserves numbers?
elena: i tried that locally. forcing base tokenizer restores correct outputs (numeric-exact-match 0.98 -> 0.97). adapter weights OK.
sam: quick fix: reconvert with --prefer-base-merges or remap adapter merges that touch digit/comma/dot tokens. which is faster?
kai: reconvert + re-quantize is fastest. also add a unit test to the smokepack covering common grouping/locale formats (commas, spaces, thin-space, NBSP).
eli: (typo) i mean elena :) i'll kick off reconvert if you two agree.
ci-bot: build/marlinpay-lora/merge-check queued by elena (job #15877)
sam: also add tokenize_debug=true to evalpack run so we can count anomalies before/after.
kai: i'll PR: conversion flag + money_smokepack tests + small remap script. will include a regex to catch numeric merges like ^\d+[\,\u00A0\s]*\d+$ in merges.
elena: timeline?
kai: reconvert + quantize + quick-eval = ~2 hours. PR: https://phabricator.redwood.ai/D14012
ci-bot: build/marlinpay-lora/merge-check started (job #15877)
sam: if fix passes local quick-eval, plan for 10% canary 8h with invoice_amount_exact_match alert at 0.92. rollback if <0.9 for >5m.
elena: thanks all, tagging this thread for follow-up when job finishes. ci job will post logs.
ci-bot: build/marlinpay-lora/merge-check finished  job #15877 (logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/15877)
